records.statement: Exchange-labelled wallet balances, ETF holdings-derived flows, Binance's reserve coverage claim and escrow eligibility are distinct measurements. Current data does not establish customer net flows, XRP-specific Binance purchases, ETF-to-exchange transfer paths or immediate escrow sell pressure. Main Cross Analysis still writes timestamp-only zero-sample output.
records.impact: Conflating custody balances with tradable float, issuer holdings changes with gross spot capital, company reserve claims with independently verified backing, or escrow eligibility with sales can contaminate XRP prediction features. Scheduled main writes can make stale data appear current.
